title: Risk panels backed by our own tests
description: Each warning opens a panel: the regulation (verified citation), the failure our measurement demonstrates with the number and a deep link to the cell and an example item, and how to avoid it.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Evidence-backed risk panels
  Scenario: Every risk claim cites a test
    Given a risk panel on any page
    When the site is built
    Then every stated failure links to a measured cell in the leaderboard data and quotes its number with its interval
  Scenario: Unbacked claims fail the build
    Given a risk statement with no linked cell or no verified citation
    When the build checks run
    Then the build fails

right_now_summary: Risk panels now link warnings to verified rules, measured failures, numbers, and example items.
